svg.title: What Commercial Leads and Appointments Cost
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-commercial-lead-and-appointment-price-bands; chapter number: 2; title: What Commercial Leads and Appointments Cost; subtitle: Reported price bands from insurance ads to qualified B2B meetings; chart type: horizontal_bars; unit: USD per lead or per booked appointment; bars: label: Exclusive Meta Home Insurance Lead; min: 8; max: 13; typical: 10.5; display: $8-$13 (Nato Guajardo); label: Truck Insurance Google Ads Lead; min: 31; max: 40; typical: 35.5; display: $31-$40, about $35-$36 at $10K spend (Max Conversion); label: Margin Check on Sale vs Generation Cost; min: 30; max: 40; typical: 40; display: $30 sale on a $40 lead = -$10 every lead (Rafael Hernandez); label: Local-Business Booked Appointment; min: 150; max: 600; typical: 250; display: $150-$600, $250 worked example (Smart Capital); label: Qualified B2B Appointment; min: 550; max: 1700; typical: 1125; display: $550-$1,700 (Clutch Research via Smart Capital); caption: Lead prices run from single digits on Meta to four figures for qualified B2B meetings, and every band has to clear the buyer's margin.; assumptions note: Typical values are the practitioner's stated point figure where one was given ($35-$36 truck insurance, $250 appointment example, $40 cost) and the range midpoint otherwise (Meta home insurance, Clutch B2B).; note: Sources - Nato Guajardo (VSivqJQ89ow), Max Conversion (kPWKWbOFwUo @ 00:00:27), Rafael Hernandez (ngsR38BAFbc @ 00:06:33), Smart Capital (ozWkxUTBug4 @ 00:04:48).
